name: Restart a Crashed Process (Windows)
description: Check whether a named process is running and start it again if it is not — a lightweight watchdog for an application that is not registered as a Windows service.

parameters.label: Process name
parameters.help: The process name without .exe, as shown by Get-Process, e.g. notepad.

parameters.label: Executable path to relaunch
parameters.help: Absolute path to the program to start when the process is not found.
